Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect to link a card that doesn't have ?

Effect: [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] You may link 1 Digimon card with the [Appmon] trait from your hand or this Digimon's digivolution cards to 1 of your Digimon without paying the cost.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When your Digimon get linked, by unsuspending this Digimon, trash your opponent's top security card.
Special Digivolution Condition: [App Fusion] [Globemon] & [Charismon]: Cost 0 (If 2 such cards are linked together, stack the link card on top and digivolve.)
